title: ScanReceipt
description: S13 BrowseAhead scan receipt (contract-first, MVP raw-only): records a web-sourced scan over caller bytes with a severity band and an ingestion hint. Sanitized-bundle-only ingestion: only the sanitized bundle (sanitizedBundleHash) is eligible for ingestion; raw bytes (rawContentHash) are quarantine/forensics only and are never ingested. scan.mode is const raw until S13 wires further modes; signature is null until the live signer lands (deferred signing: null means unsigned, not invalid).

mode.description: MVP raw-only scan mode. Any other mode is rejected until S13 wires it.

provenance.description: Byte provenance. caller_supplied: the scanned bytes came from the caller (customer-finder/citation path input). fetched: the gateway fetched the URL itself, in which case sourceUri is required. fetched-provenance on caller bytes is rejected: callers must declare caller_supplied.

policyVersion.description: BrowseAhead policy version applied, e.g. browseahead-policy.v1.

sourceUri.description: Where the bytes were fetched from. Required when provenance is fetched.

severity.description: Severity band for the scan finding.

ingestionHint.description: Downstream ingestion directive: allow (ingest sanitized bundle), quarantine (hold for review), fail_closed (block the dependent effect; beta stays fail-closed).

sanitizedBundleHash.description: Hash of the sanitized bundle eligible for ingestion, in sha256:<hex> form (mirrors RuntimeReceiptFactory.HashSeed output shape). Only sanitized bytes ingest.

rawContentHash.description: Hash of the pre-sanitization bytes, in sha256:<hex> form. Quarantine/forensics only; never ingested.

canonicalSha256.description: MarketOps canonical hash (bare hex) of the canonical scan record.

signature.description: Deferred-signing note: null in MVP (no live signer yet); null means unsigned, not invalid. Populated once S13 wires the live signer.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant key. Scan receipts are tenant-scoped; cross-tenant scan state must never leak.

actorId.description: Actor the scan ran for (user:{guid} or system:{component}); tenant bind stays in tenantId.

correlationId.description: MarketOps correlation id threading this scan into downstream receipts (PublishPacket.correlationId; gateway correlation_id on the wire).
